Agent 保存模型、指令、Skills 和 MCP。开始会话时选择运行时，每个: An Agent combines a model, instructions, Skills and MCP. Choose a runtime when starting a conversation; each conversation has its own workspace and history.
Skills 是可复用的执行方法。上传 ZIP，或用 SKILL.md 创建。绑: Skills are reusable methods. Upload a ZIP or create a SKILL.md, then bind it to an Agent. Workspace sessions load the selected Skills; text-only environments do not.
daemon 以启动用户的权限执行，可访问该用户有权访问的文件和网络。工作目录必: The daemon runs with its user's permissions and file and network access. The workspace must already exist. Windows supports Codex and Claude Code.
oc_…，或 p2p 接收私聊: oc_…, or p2p for direct messages
个会话用量未知 · 费用未提供: conversations with unknown usage · Cost unavailable
什么时候使用、具体步骤、预期输出: When to use it, steps and expected output
从本次发送开始计时：请求返回记录发送接口完成；首个文本增量记录浏览器首次收到非空: Timing starts when sending: request latency ends when submission returns; first text measures the first nonempty streamed text received. Unobserved values display —; history polling is not used to estimate them.
任务状态记录交付进度，可在检查结果后更新。: Task status tracks delivery progress. Update it after reviewing the result.
会话空闲且运行环境就绪后可以上传。: Upload when the conversation is idle and the environment is ready.
保存不会启动执行。修改用于下一次分配，已有会话保留其原始配置。: Saving does not start execution. Changes apply to future dispatches; existing conversations retain their configuration.
允许 Agent 提问业务信息（不用于执行审批）: Let the Agent ask for task information (never execution approval)
允许群成员切换 Agent（共享机器人）: Allow members to switch Agents (shared bot)
写下目标，分配给 Agent，跟踪执行过程，再由你验收。: Describe the goal, assign an Agent, follow execution and review the result.
删除此 Skill 及全部版本？请先解除 Agent 中的绑定。: Delete this Skill and all versions? Remove its Agent bindings first.
删除此任务及其评论？: Delete this task and its comments?
删除此会话及其执行历史？正在执行时需先取消。: Delete this conversation and execution history? Cancel active execution first.
删除此能力及其所有版本？: Delete this capability and all versions?
删除此计划？已创建的任务会保留。: Delete this schedule? Created tasks will be kept.
删除这个项目？项目有任务时不能删除。: Delete this project? Projects with tasks cannot be deleted.
包含 Skill 或 Plugin 的绝对目录: Absolute directory containing Skills or Plugins
同一话题继续同一个执行会话。配置更改作用于新话题。支持 /cancel、/rev: Replies in a thread continue its conversation. Configuration changes affect new threads. Use /cancel, /review, /done or /reopen. Results return to the thread; files are available in the web conversation.
启用后，在允许的飞书群中 @机器人 发送第一项任务。: After enabling, mention the bot in an allowed group to send your first task.
命令包含临时连接授权，请勿分享。过期后页面会自动获取新命令。: This command contains temporary connection authorization. Do not share it. The page refreshes expired commands automatically.
地址和密钥用于获取此 Provider 的模型列表。密钥仅保存在本机后端，不返回: The URL and key retrieve this Provider's model list. Keys stay in the local backend. Codex and Claude Code workspace sessions use this connection; text-only and MiniMax Code sessions use Core's deployment connection.
填入任务说明，连接后发送: Insert task brief; send after connecting
复制失败，请手动选择代码: Copy failed; select the code manually
复制失败，请手动选择代码。: Copy failed; select the code manually.
如请求结果未确定，可关闭弹窗，在会话列表中恢复同一次创建。: If creation is unconfirmed, close this dialog and recover the same request from the conversation list.
安装命令暂不可用，请检查 Core 的原生安装包配置，或稍后重试。: Installation command unavailable. Check Core's native package configuration or retry later.
安装器会下载与 Core 匹配的 Runtime 和所选执行引擎，创建工作目录并: The installer downloads a Runtime matching Core and the selected engine, prepares the workspace and connects this conversation. Claude Code on Windows requires Git Bash. The Runtime uses its user's permissions.
安装完成并显示「已连接」后，即可发送消息。: Send a message after installation completes and the status is Connected.
密钥只写入 Core Vault，不返回浏览器。: Secrets are written to Core Vault and never returned to the browser.
已请求取消，等待执行结束。: Cancellation requested; waiting for execution to stop.
开启会话时选择运行时。用户机器保存平台和工作目录，每个会话单独连接；这里不代表机: Choose a runtime when starting a conversation. User-machine configurations store platform and workspace; each conversation connects separately. This is not a machine availability indicator.
当前会话已失败，请返回会话列表新建会话: This conversation failed. Return to the list to start another.
新任务解析默认版本，已启动任务保留技能快照。删除会影响绑定此 Skill 的新任: New tasks resolve the default version; started tasks retain their Skill snapshot. Remove Agent bindings before deleting this Skill.
无法读取文件，请重新选择。: Unable to read file. Select it again.
最多选择 8 个 MCP。托管会话从工作区连接，纯文本会话从 Core 连接；用: Select up to 8 MCP servers. Workspace sessions connect from their environment; text-only sessions connect from Core.
最多选择 8 个技能，运行时需支持托管沙箱。新会话使用技能的默认版本。: Select up to 8 Skills for workspace sessions. New conversations use the default version.
服务器运行时生效。每次读取模板的当前配置；已发出的请求保持不变。暂时断线会自动恢: Schedules run while the server is running. Each occurrence reads the current template; admitted requests stay frozen. Transient failures recover automatically. Rejected configurations pause the schedule until corrected.
正在重连实时回复，历史仍会自动更新。: Reconnecting the live response. History continues to refresh.
此组合使用 Core 部署的模型连接；这里选择的 Provider 仅用于模型分: This combination uses Core's deployment model connection. The selected Provider is a catalog group.
每个 Agent 可绑定独立机器人，也可使用共享机器人。支持群聊与私聊。: Give each Agent a dedicated bot or use a shared bot. Group chats and direct messages are supported.
每个会话使用独立的 Runtime 安装目录。续聊使用原会话和工作目录； 重新连: Each conversation has a separate Runtime installation. Continue the original conversation to retain its workspace; reconnect using the original installation directory.
每个会话独立保存工作区和历史。修改 Agent 配置只影响新会话。: Each conversation has its own workspace and history. Agent edits affect new conversations.
每次上传一个文件，最大 5 MiB。文件进入当前工作区，路径会插入消息草稿；发送: Upload one file at a time, up to 5 MiB. Its workspace path is inserted into your draft; the Agent processes it after you send. Upload while idle. Ask the Agent to save results under outputs/ for download here.
每次分配创建独立会话；追问请继续原会话。执行完成后检查结果，再提交验收。: Each dispatch creates a conversation. Continue that conversation for follow-ups. Review the results when execution finishes.
没有模型，可以添加自定义模型。: No models found. Add a custom model.
添加 Provider，选择需要的模型: Add a Provider and select models
用 /list 和 /select 选择此安装中的 Agent；关闭时固定使用下: Use /list and /select to choose an Agent. Disable this to use the fixed Agent below. Preferences are saved per member and apply to new tasks.
用任务说明替换当前草稿？: Replace the draft with the task brief?
用户机器需要先创建会话，再按连接指引启动 daemon，连接后发送消息。此会话使: For a user machine, create the conversation, connect the daemon, then send. The conversation freezes the Agent configuration. Hosted conversations have independent workspaces. Continue a conversation to retain its history and active workspace. Text-only environments have no workspace.
目标、约束、交付标准和 Agent 需要了解的背景: Goal, constraints, acceptance criteria and context
编辑任务，选择 Agent 和运行时后即可分配执行。: Select an Agent and runtime to dispatch this task.
获取 Provider 的模型列表，勾选或自定义后保存。Agent 选择已绑定的: Fetch the Provider's models, select or add entries, then save. Agents use these configured models.
要解决什么问题？期待的交付物和验收标准是什么？: What problem should be solved? Define deliverables and acceptance criteria.
记录项目背景，然后把具体工作交给 Agent。: Record the project context, then assign work to an Agent.
记录验收意见、决定或下一步…: Record feedback, decisions or next steps…
评论用于工作记录；与 Agent 追问请打开会话。: Comments record discussion. Open the conversation to follow up with the Agent.
还没有执行记录。任务说明和项目背景会一起交给 Agent。: No execution history yet. The task brief and project context will be sent together.
连接中断会按相同请求标识重试。超过重试上限或飞书去重窗口的记录会保留为「需要处理: Interrupted requests retry with the same identity. Unconfirmed deliveries outside Feishu's deduplication window remain visible for manual review.
选择任务模板，设置间隔或 Cron 与时区。: Choose a task template, then set an interval or Cron expression and timezone.
配置 HTTP MCP 服务，Agent可绑定多个服务。当前支持无需认证的 HT: Configure HTTPS MCP servers and bind them to Agents. Workspace sessions connect from the environment; text-only sessions connect from Core. Select a Vault for authenticated servers.
项目背景会随任务发送。仓库地址作为上下文；访问权限和检出由执行环境负责。: Project context is sent with each task. Repository access and checkout are handled in the execution environment.
最多选择 8 个技能，可使用默认版本或固定版本。托管沙箱和用户机器支持技能。: Select up to 8 Skills, using the default or a pinned version. Hosted sandboxes and user machines support Skills.
最多选择 8 个 MCP。沙箱和用户机器从工作区连接，纯文本会话从 Core 连: Select up to 8 MCP servers. Sandboxes and user machines connect from the workspace; text-only sessions connect from Core.
移除 Provider {{value0}}？请先移除其中的模型。: Remove provider {{value0}}? Remove its models first.
{{value0}} 上传未确认，文件可能已写入 {{value1}}。请先检查: Upload of {{value0}} was not confirmed; the file may already exist at {{value1}}. Check the path before uploading again.
文件预览超过 32 MiB 限制。: File preview exceeds the 32 MiB limit.
文件过大，请下载查看。: File is too large. Download it to view.
Core 返回了无效的历史分页游标。: Core returned an invalid history cursor.
历史超过 10,000 条，当前示例无法完整展示。: History exceeds 10,000 records and cannot be fully displayed.
使用飞书扫码并确认创建应用。应用密钥仅保存在服务器；完成后配置分配规则并启用机器: Scan with Feishu and confirm app creation. The app secret stays on the server. Configure routing and enable the bot after registration.
授权已结束，请重新获取二维码。: Authorization ended. Request a new QR code.
Agent 需要补充业务信息时会出现在这里。执行始终使用 bypass。: Questions appear here when Agents need business information. Execution always uses bypass.
配置 HTTPS MCP 服务，可绑定凭据库中的凭据。沙箱和用户机器从工作区连接: Configure HTTPS MCP servers and bind credentials from a Vault. Sandboxes and user machines connect from the workspace; text-only sessions connect from Core.
此服务需要认证，请绑定对应服务的凭据。: This service requires authentication. Bind a credential for this server.
技能目录暂不可用，可直接输入仓库和技能名称。: The directory is unavailable. Enter a repository and Skill name directly.
技能目录返回了无法识别的数据。: The directory returned an unsupported response.
新话题附带最近群消息（需要历史消息权限）: Include recent group messages in new threads (requires message history permission)
将在服务商页面授权。授权完成后凭据保存在当前凭据库，可用于 MCP 配置。: Authorize on the provider’s page. The credential will be saved in this Vault for use with MCP.
授权未完成，请返回凭据页面重试。: Authorization was not completed. Return to Credentials and try again.
服务商授权已完成，点击保存凭据。: Provider authorization is complete. Save the credential to continue.
提供 ask_agent 和 get_run。使用 Agent 的默认运行时，业: Provides ask_agent and get_run using the Agent’s default runtime. Answer business questions in Parsar. This endpoint is available only to local clients.
替换后旧密钥立即失效，继续？: Replacing this token immediately revokes the previous token. Continue?
密钥仅显示一次，请复制到客户端配置。: This token is shown only once. Copy it into your client configuration.
前端扩展不能超过 1 MiB。: Frontend extensions must not exceed 1 MiB.
仅安装你信任的前端扩展。它以当前页面的权限运行，可访问 Parsar 数据和公开: Install only frontend extensions you trust. They run with this page’s permissions and can access Parsar data and the public API.
设置估算价格（美元 / 百万 Token）: Set estimated pricing (USD per million tokens)
